articleTitle: Why Libido Drops After Kids (and What Actually Helps)
imageHeadline: Your libido didn't break. Your capacity did.
imageSubtext: What's really driving low desire after kids—and what helps more than scheduling
pinTitle: Why Libido Drops After Kids (and What Actually Helps)
pinDescription: Loss of desire after having children isn't just exhaustion. Hormones, touch overload, sleep deprivation, and identity shifts all play a role—and scheduling sex often backfires when you're already running on empty. Explore what's really driving it and practical approaches that address the root causes, not just the symptom.

items.label: Prolactin from breastfeeding suppresses estrogen & desire
Touch overload is nervous system saturation, not rejection
Desire often follows connection, not the other way around
